body: Universal LLM Deployment Engine with ML Compilation
plain_description: **Deploy large language models across your platforms with one high-performance engine.** Compile and run models on desktop, mobile, and web platforms. Connect through OpenAI-compatible APIs.
technical_description: MLC LLM is a machine learning compiler and high-performance deployment engine for large language models. It compiles and runs models through MLCEngine across desktop, mobile, and web platforms, with support for AMD, NVIDIA, Apple, and Intel GPUs. MLCEngine offers an OpenAI-compatible API through a REST server and Python, JavaScript, iOS, and Android interfaces.
title: MLC LLM
